fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-07-01 (evening, 17:20): Nithya Rani paid Rs. 40,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered. Bhuvana Bai (9000000344) reported the matter for Nithya Rani, whose contact number is given as 9000000035. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Arjun Shankar, using the number 9000000136. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100055 as the destination of the transfer. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly issued a forged offer letter and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, evening, main street, receiving account, mobile number, documents, suspect
